title: Black College Student DESTROYS Arrogant MAGA Debater Over His Anti-DEI Argument
description:
In this video, Will Witt from Turning Point USA sits down with a liberal guest for a head to head debate about DEI, affirmative action, and the real reasons behind racial inequality in America. What starts as a simple question about hiring the best person for the job quickly turns into one of the most revealing conversations about diversity, equity, and inclusion you will see this year. Will Witt pushes the argument that outcomes come down to personal responsibility and culture, while the guest keeps pointing back at the system itself, from housing policy to education access. The result is a sharp, fast moving exchange that gets to the heart of how the left and the right actually see opportunity in this country.

This debate covers a lot of ground. It opens with the classic hiring hypothetical, the idea that employers should always pick the most qualified candidate regardless of race, gender, or sexuality. From there the conversation moves into whether diversity, equity, and inclusion programs help level the playing field or create a new form of unfairness. Will Witt argues that DEI and affirmative action judge people by immutable characteristics instead of merit. The liberal guest counters that the original intent of these policies was never about handing out jobs based on skin color, but about making sure applicants from every background actually get considered in the first place. That single distinction becomes the pressure point of the entire discussion.
